images.filename: Belgio - Gand - ponte San Michele, chiesa San Michele e fiume Lys.jpg
images.caption:
St. Michael's Bridge crosses the river Lys (Leie), on the southern side of Graslei and Korenlei; it is the only place from which it's possible to  admire the three towers of Ghent (St. Nicholas' Church, St. Bavo's Cathedral, and the Belfry).
St. Michael's Church is a large late-Gothic church; it's contain notable works of art.
